summary: flyExclusive, Inc. owns and operates jet aircraft in North America. The company also offers jet charter services; aircraft maintenance, modification, repair, inspection, overhaul operation services; interior and exterior refurbishment services; and aircraft management services, as well as wholesale and retail ad hoc flights, a jet club program, partnership program, fractional program, and other services. flyExclusive, Inc. is headquartered in Kinston, North Carolina.
